title: Surreal Eastern Horizon
description: A dramatic surreal landscape depicts a large fiery red chrysanthemum blooming in a stormy sky, connected by glowing light trails to celestial symbols including a yin-yang and an intricate circular diagram. Below, traditional Chinese pagodas stand on the misty shoreline of a lake where several illuminated boats float on calm water.
prompt: Surreal East Asian fantasy landscape at dusk, massive vibrant red chrysanthemum exploding in a stormy sky, connected by glowing energy trails to a large yin-yang symbol and an ancient circular astronomical diagram floating above a misty lake. Traditional Chinese pagodas on the distant shore, several illuminated wooden boats drifting on calm water, dramatic cloudy sky with golden light breaking through, painterly oil painting style with visible brushstrokes.
